narrative:
Hardin County has 17,298 registered voters, with 13.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 35.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 47.5%, a clear Democratic lean of 11.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 27.7% of registrants.
